title: Oracle Midday Brief
script_summary:
Bitcoin slips 2% to $64,774 as fear tightens its grip, with the index at 31. US morning session shows steady selling pressure without major catalysts. 

Hashrate remains robust at 731 EH/s, signaling miner conviction despite the dip. Mempool holds 93,000 transactions with fees bottoming at 3 sat/vB, pointing to light congestion and cheap entry for users. Block height ticks to 959,291.
